rules.rule: Every run passes the project-config gate before anything else
must: Every\ srd\ skill\ runs\ this\ gate\ first,\ in\ every\ mode,\ before\ reading\ the\ SRD

rules.rule: A failed gate check stops the run; no REST, checkout, or offline fallback
must: Stop\ before\ any\ other\ work\ and\ say\ exactly\ which\ check\ failed
Never\ fall\ back\ to\ a\ REST\ call,\ a\ local\ checkout,\ or\ offline\ work

rules.rule: The SRD standard is fetched live, never a stored copy
must: Never\ use\ a\ stored\ or\ remembered\ copy

rules.rule: Never marks an SRD ACCEPTED; acceptance is human
must: never\ marks\ an\ SRD\ `ACCEPTED`:\ acceptance\ is\ a\ human\ decision
Do\ not\ mark\ the\ draft\ acceptable

rules.rule: No file is written until every Quality-Bar blocker is settled with the user
must: Write\ only\ once\ step\ 4\ has\ settled\ every\ blocker
An\ authoring\ skill\ does\ not\ knowingly\ write\ a\ defect\ it\ has\ already\ named

rules.rule: Interview asks one branch at a time, no bundled questions
must: Ask\ one\ branch\ at\ a\ time
no\ bundled\ questions

rules.rule: A claim about the existing system is searched in the corpus before acceptance; contradictions surfaced
must: `search`\ the\ corpus\ before\ accepting\ it
never\ silently\ accept\ or\ fix

rules.rule: A platform fact reaches srd:kb only after the branch restatement is confirmed, never by a separate prompt
must: reaches\ `srd:kb`\ only\ once\ that\ restatement\ is\ confirmed
never\ through\ a\ separate\ prompt

rules.rule: Doc gaps are captured as drafts and offered at step 5, never filed silently
must: Gaps\ are\ captured\ as\ server\-side\ drafts\ on\ discovery\ and\ offered\ at\ step\ 5
a\ draft\ left\ without\ a\ path\ is\ invisible\ to\ every\ later\ draft\ check

rules.rule: Owners, Initiative, Designs are placeholders; Status is IN PROGRESS
must: Do\ not\ collect\ Owners,\ Initiative\ links,\ or\ Designs\ links
Status\ is\ always\ `IN\ PROGRESS`\ for\ a\ new\ draft

rules.rule: Report counts only, read off the finished file
must: counts\ only
read\ off\ the\ finished\ artifact,\ never\ carried\ from\ the\ work\ that\ produced\ it
